patch:
diff --git a/seaborn/_core/plot.py b/seaborn/_core/plot.py
index 8915616b..9d32652a 100644
--- a/seaborn/_core/plot.py
+++ b/seaborn/_core/plot.py
@@ -1561,7 +1561,7 @@ class Plotter:
         for var in legend_vars:
             var_legend = scales[var]._legend
             if var_legend is not None:
-                values, labels = var_legend
+                values, labels, offset = var_legend
                 for (_, part_id), part_vars, _ in schema:
                     if data.ids[var] == part_id:
                         # Allow multiple plot semantics to represent same data variable
@@ -1569,6 +1569,8 @@ class Plotter:
                         break
                 else:
                     title = self._resolve_label(p, var, data.names[var])
+                    if offset:
+                        title = f"{title} ({offset})"
                     entry = (title, data.ids[var]), [var], (values, labels)
                     schema.append(entry)
 
diff --git a/seaborn/_core/scales.py b/seaborn/_core/scales.py
index 55874bf2..cb5679e3 100644
--- a/seaborn/_core/scales.py
+++ b/seaborn/_core/scales.py
@@ -60,7 +60,7 @@ class Scale:
     _pipeline: Pipeline
     _matplotlib_scale: ScaleBase
     _spacer: staticmethod
-    _legend: tuple[list[str], list[Any]] | None
+    _legend: tuple[list[Any], list[str], str] | None
 
     def __post_init__(self):
 
@@ -229,7 +229,7 @@ class Nominal(Scale):
         new._spacer = spacer
 
         if prop.legend:
-            new._legend = units_seed, list(stringify(units_seed))
+            new._legend = units_seed, list(stringify(units_seed)), ""
 
         return new
 
@@ -379,7 +379,8 @@ class ContinuousBase(Scale):
             locs = axis.major.locator()
             locs = locs[(vmin <= locs) & (locs <= vmax)]
             labels = axis.major.formatter.format_ticks(locs)
-            new._legend = list(locs), list(labels)
+            offset = axis.major.formatter.get_offset()
+            new._legend = list(locs), list(labels), offset
 
         return new
